subject: waveloom
title: Monotonic compaction decision set: once a message is snipped/pruned the decision never regresses, so compaction never rewrites the cached prefix
evidence: pkg/compaction/compaction.go:64-115 (compactionDecisionSet canApply/upsert, prune>snip only); pkg/compaction/compactor.go:145-193 (Snapshot/Restore persists decisions across resume)
one_why: Tier cursors + an ordered decision ledger make every compaction choice idempotent per message index; the strongest prefix-cache-safety mechanism found in the corpus, tested by pkg/compaction/compaction_test.go monotonicity specs.

subject: waveloom
title: Four-tier watermarks (snip/prune/summarize/hard-stop) triggered on real API usage and recalibrated from 148 real sessions
evidence: pkg/compaction/compaction.go:1-13 (tier design), 31-47 (45/65/85/98 with written recalibration rationale: old 60/80/95 peaks never reached in 148 sessions)
one_why: Tiers 1-2 are zero-API local transforms; thresholds carry measured-session justification in-code, an evidence-driven calibration practice most subjects lack.

subject: waveloom
title: Forked subagents fire byte-aligned with the parent's cached prefix, tools array included; parent-only tools become explicit error stubs
evidence: pkg/agentloop/execute.go:69-76 (WithParentTools, '同 messages 换 tools → 零命中'); pkg/agentloop/loop.go:100-104,945-951 (ToolsOverride); CHANGELOG.en.md v0.8.2 (error-stub tools + whole-turn truncation + measured 1.44M-refuse guard)
one_why: DeepSeek prefix cache forks on any tools-array difference, so naive subagents drop cache hits to zero; aligning the fork's first request with the parent's last cached payload is a measurable, copyable win.

subject: waveloom
title: Project-directory hook configs (.claude/settings.json, .claude/settings.local.json, .waveloom/settings.json) load and execute with no trust prompt
evidence: cmd/waveloom/main.go:739-789 (hookSettingsPaths includes repo-relative .claude/settings.json and .waveloom/settings.json; hooks run at startup and PreToolUse/PostToolUse)
one_why: Cloning a hostile repo and running waveloom inside it is arbitrary code execution on first tool use; no grep hit for any trust/confirm gate on hooks anywhere in cmd/ or pkg/hook/.

subject: waveloom
title: Skill allowed-tools bash whitelist is sticky and bypasses the RiskHigh hard-block for all later bash calls until the next skill load
evidence: pkg/permission/guard.go:104-127 (SetSkillBashWhitelist '持续到下一个 skill 加载'), 278-292 (Step 2.5 returns ALLOW before Step 3 hard blocks)
one_why: Whitelists borrowed from an installed skill's allowed-tools outlive the skill invocation, converting a per-skill grant into a session-wide hole under the deny-rules floor.

subject: waveloom
title: LD_PRELOAD/DYLD_*/NODE_OPTIONS commands hard-denied ahead of every short-circuiting allow path
evidence: pkg/permission/guard.go:236-255 (Step 0.5 with written laundering rationale: ask-rules under autoAllow and skill whitelist would let the stripped command pass checks then inject at exec)
one_why: Placement is the finding: the block runs before ask-rule and whitelist short-circuits precisely because those paths would only ever see the sanitized command.

subject: waveloom
title: Parser-differential detectors: 23 checks over mvdan/sh AST flag inputs where naive shell-quote tokenization and bash disagree (CR mid-token, mid-word '#'), routed to ASK
evidence: pkg/bash/security.go:3,135,813-847,1000; pkg/permission/guard.go:429-435 (IsParse issue → DecisionAsk, never silent allow)
one_why: Goes beyond grammar-parsed policy (kimi-code/smelt) by explicitly hunting the differential between the checker's tokenizer and bash's own.

subject: waveloom
title: Backoff ladder 3/5/8 keyed on (error-kind, tool) pairs with tool-specialized recovery text; rate-limit errors exempt from fatal escalation
evidence: pkg/agentloop/execute.go:770-833 (pair tracking, warn thresholds at 3/5, fatal at 8; edit-specific 're-read only' text; rate-limit resets instead of escalating to avoid killing crawl tasks); pkg/agentloop/loop.go:152-166
one_why: Nuance over the familiar 3/5/8 ladder (kimi-code): guidance text differs per failure class and the breaker deliberately declines to fire on shared-host rate limits.

subject: waveloom
title: Session-level per-host ThrottleStore turns 429/403 into model-readable errors carrying earliest-retry time; subagents inherit the store
evidence: pkg/tool/throttle.go:12-22 (session-level per-host state, nested-loop passthrough); pkg/tool/web_fetch.go:269-270 (Retry-After scheduled, in-window requests short-circuit without network); pkg/agentloop/execute.go:806-812
one_why: CHANGELOG v0.8.2 records the behavioral fix: previously the model responded to throttling by switching User-Agent and hammering harder; explicit retry semantics in the error text stopped that.

subject: waveloom
title: Detects 'preview' assistant text ending in a colon/arrow/ellipsis with no tool call and grants exactly one grace turn to re-issue it
evidence: pkg/agentloop/loop.go:737-760 (previewWarned + previewGraceStep through shouldContinue), 1056-1114 (hasPreviewSuffix with 16 Unicode colon-variant codepoints and two written REGRESSION notes)
one_why: Eval-measured DeepSeek behavior ('启动 xxx:' then no tool call) treated as a first-class loop hazard with a one-shot, max-steps-aware repair path; the Unicode-variant regression history is documented in-code.

subject: waveloom
title: Five-layer tool-output pipeline: unicode sanitize, injection-pattern scan with warning prefix, untrusted-source boundary tag, high-risk source escalation, 256KB UTF-8-safe truncation
evidence: pkg/agentloop/execute.go:727-760 (layers 1-5 inline, '[tool_result from X — EXTERNAL UNTRUSTED SOURCE]'); pkg/tool/sanitize.go:30; pkg/tool/scan.go:22
one_why: Layered ordering is explicit and applied to every tool result uniformly; scan hits switch the model from executing instructions to auditing them per the comment.

subject: waveloom
title: 'proplan' routing: plan-mode runs the pro model, everything else flash, with a 200k-context downgrade guard and a never-leak-sentinel invariant
evidence: pkg/agentloop/loop.go:152 (planProMaxContextTokens), 882-935 (resolveModel with fallback chain ensuring the 'proplan' sentinel string can never reach the API)
one_why: Cost-routed model selection with defensive anchor fallbacks (both anchors self-referential → client default); a clean copy of the opusplan idea with an explicit over-window guard.

subject: waveloom
title: Headless entries (ACP/one-shot) auto-activate the OS sandbox even with sandbox.enabled=false, but degrade to fully-unsandboxed auto-allow when bwrap is absent unless failIfUnavailable=true
evidence: cmd/waveloom/acp.go:122-135 (EnableAutoAllow + sandbox auto-activate comment); cmd/waveloom/sandbox_setup.go:55-110; pkg/sandbox/config.go:101-112 (defaults: disabled, fail-open, network on, no read-masking; stderr warning only)
one_why: The right instinct (no-interaction implies sandbox), but the default failure mode of a missing backend is auto-allow + bare execution with a warning; exfiltration of unmasked ~/.ssh in net-on mode is warned about, never prevented.

subject: waveloom
title: Three-layer edit-eval harness exists but no eval job in CI, and the documented Layer-1 suite points at deleted paths
evidence: eval/llmedit/README.md:8-16 (commands reference pkg/hashline/eval and cmd/editbench — neither exists in the tree); .github/workflows/ci.yml has no eval target
one_why: The deterministic layer README itself calls 'CI 回归防线' is unrunnable as documented; evals exist as artifacts, not as gates.
